name: 13365-ngramspec-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct -- the ungated re-upload of the 8B Llama-3 Instruct weights (meta-llama's own repo is gated); 16.1 GB bf16.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process V1 engine (VLLM_USE_V1=1).
architecture: dense decoder, LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, 8.03e9 params, bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup 10% and cooldown 10%, bounded at 5000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: ShareGPT single-turn replay, 5000 requests from `configs/data/sharegpt-5000.jsonl`. Prompt tokens mean 221 (p50 98, p95 766, max 1021), output tokens mean 201 (p50 135, p95 631, max 1853); 1104092 prompt and 1004593 output tokens in total. Output length comes from the row and the backend sets `ignore_eos`, so the generated token count is fixed by the corpus rather than by sampling.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant built on an 8-billion-parameter model, streaming 128 concurrent short conversations from one GPU.
launch:
# The serving configuration. VLLM_USE_V1=1 is mandatory and is an environment variable, not a
# flag: it is read at import time, so it must be set before vllm is imported. configs/tuned.yaml
# carries it; without it the run silently completes on V0.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

# N-gram (prompt-lookup) speculative decoding. `--speculative-config`, the single-JSON spelling,
# does not exist in this engine -- these four flags are what it has, and `ngram-prompt-lookup-min`
# is not optional: the model runner asserts on it whenever a speculative config is present.
# QUOTED ON PURPOSE: bare [ngram] is a one-element YAML list, and this file is read both by a
# real YAML parser and by a flat line reader.
speculative-model: "[ngram]"
num-speculative-tokens: 3
ngram-prompt-lookup-min: 3
ngram-prompt-lookup-max: 5

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-model-len: 8192
